proof_atom_acceptance.signed_release_gate: A citation is accepting only when its canonical corpus_citation_path resolves in the immutable signed release selected by the authorized RuleSpec toolchain pin. Presence in a git checkout alone is insufficient.
proof_atom_acceptance.source_identity: For the new enactment, the promoted source must retain the official-publication PDF SHA-256 033bfdecb456d5b901bdf31e3a10b362a89bfdccc925d816d038a6e727d1c9d5, official authority metadata, publication date, language, physical page, and article/subdivision.
proof_atom_acceptance.verbatim: Every proof excerpt must be an exact substring of the promoted provision body. Do not normalize punctuation, spacing, decimal separators, ligatures, capitalization, spelling, placeholders, or printed defects inside the excerpt.
proof_atom_acceptance.source_verification_shape: Replace frontier locator objects with the repository's accepted canonical source-verification shape: corpus_citation_path plus source_sha256. Do not retain authority/page/article fields as substitutes for a citation path.
proof_atom_acceptance.value_atoms: Every currency parameter, currency table cell, rate, policy-bearing count or age, rounding literal, and policy-bearing derived money literal must have a direct atom or a proved legal import. A timing clause alone cannot prove a value.
proof_atom_acceptance.formula_atoms: Indexation, selection, proration, allocation, ceiling, and rounding formulas require the exact operative mechanism excerpt. Cross-provision formulas must cite or import every independently operative provision.
proof_atom_acceptance.timing: Every effective_from transition must retain the exact applicable/entry-into-force paragraph in effective-period evidence. Assessment-year mapping may not be inferred only from article order.
proof_atom_acceptance.delegation: A decree, confirmation act, CPI observation, corrigendum, or later consolidation receives its own source and proof. The 15 July 2026 law cannot prove a value it delegates or an empirical observation it does not print.
proof_atom_acceptance.bilingual_defects: Keep each defective French or Dutch string unaltered. Put adjudication in metadata and require independent operative support; do not repair the corpus body.
proof_atom_acceptance.no_waiver_or_pseudo_path: No waiver, invented corpus path, scoring artifact, or M.B.-page-only locator can satisfy proof acceptance.
